dct_description_sm: Main purpose of this project was to create a corpus of data, that will be able to test the following hypotheses: (1) exposure to environmental contaminants is associated to behavioural impairment in 17-year old teenagers from Nunavik, and (2) exposure to environmental contaminants is associated to impairment of the stress system assessed through physiological indicators in 17 year-old teenagers but also in adults fro Nunavik.
dct_subject_sm: Health sciences and contaminants -> Inuit Health Survey
Health sciences and contaminants -> Blood samples
Health sciences and contaminants -> Health risk
dct_title_s: Nunavik Child Cohort Study (NCCS): add-on study for follow-up with teenage children - observed behaviours and stress
